record.material_as_written: PVDF-HFP/Pyr13FSI/LiFSI gel electrolyte (GPE) at 3:1 mass ratio of IL solution to PVDF-HFP
record.evidence_quote: high conductivity, reaching 3.3 mS/cm at the mass ratio of 3:1, as shown in Fig. 2b and Fig. S3.
record.notes: Gel electrolyte is a quasi-solid polymer electrolyte with ionic liquid plasticizer; the value is stated as room-temperature conductivity in the introduction and results. EIS measured on SS/GPE/SS cell per Electrochemical measurements section. The 3:1 ratio is the GPE composition used for the full battery. Value repeated in the introduction as '(3.3 mS/cm)' with no separate measurement.
